tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find homes, land or commercial property for sale or rent in Greece (Athens, Attica, the islands, the Peloponnese and elsewhere) within a budget, area, type or size. tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one specific Greca House listing by its reference (for example GH-108459), usually after a search. Returns the public description, facts, features, photos, 3D/360°/video links, Golden Visa classification and the listing URL.
